cards.claim: Lower training resolution with fine-tuning at test resolution provides an efficient strategy to optimize performance when train and test resolutions differ
cards.conditions: ImageNet classification, ResNet-50 and ResNeXt-101, multiple resolutions tested (128x128, 224x224, 320x320)
cards.effect: Enables strong classifiers using small training images; achieves 77.1% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet with ResNet-50 trained on 128x128 images
cards.evidence: Experimental validation on ImageNet with specified model architectures and resolution combinations
cards.quote: we propose a simple yet effective and efficient strategy to optimize the classifier performance when the train and test resolutions differ. It involves only a computationally cheap fine-tuning of the network at the test resolution. This enables training strong classifiers using small training images. For instance, we obtain 77.1% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet with a ResNet-50 trained on 128x128 images, and 79.8% with one trained on 224x224 image.

cards.claim: Training resolution affects achievable accuracy at a fixed test resolution
cards.conditions: ImageNet, ResNet-50, test resolution fixed while varying train resolution
cards.effect: Training at 224x224 achieves 79.8% vs 77.1% at 128x128 (2.7pp gain); with extra data reaches 82.5%
cards.evidence: Direct experimental comparison across resolution conditions
cards.quote: For instance, we obtain 77.1% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet with a ResNet-50 trained on 128x128 images, and 79.8% with one trained on 224x224 image. In addition, if we use extra training data we get 82.5% with the ResNet-50 train with 224x224 images.

cards.claim: Test resolution is a significant factor in final accuracy
cards.conditions: ImageNet, ResNeXt-101 32x48d pre-trained on 940M weakly-supervised images at 224x224, optimized for different test resolutions
cards.effect: Test resolution 320x320 achieves 86.4% top-1 accuracy vs lower resolutions shown in previous results
cards.evidence: Experimental comparison with large-scale pre-training and resolution optimization
cards.quote: when training a ResNeXt-101 32x48d pre-trained in weakly-supervised fashion on 940 million public images at resolution 224x224 and further optimizing for test resolution 320x320, we obtain a test top-1 accuracy of 86.4% (top-5: 98.0%) (single-crop).
